item.title: Week 10: Chiefs at Falcons
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: KC -3 · O/U 47.5 | Model ATL 35% vs. market 39% | On paper, Kansas City leads on play action, ranking 3rd in EPA per play-action dropback (+0.25) against Atlanta's 30th-ranked defense, while Atlanta's best counter is red-zone scoring at 59% (17th) versus Kansas City's 2nd-ranked defense at 50% allowed. Mahomes ranks 8th of 31 in EPA per dropback versus Penix Jr. at 22nd, and Drake London, who draws 27% of Atlanta's targets, meets a Kansas City pass defense ranked 23rd.
